g.desc: Each point pairs IGHG2 with one parent record in Canonical Human at ≥8/9 core identity; all 14 matching records are shown. The x-axis shows antigen target coverage and the y-axis shows mimicry parent coverage, each as a percentage of that record’s length. Overlapping cores count once, including mismatching positions; context flanks are excluded. The diagonal marks equal coverage percentages. The accompanying summary pools target coverage across all matching parents; window coverage is the percentage of eligible target starts with a match. Thresholds that have not been computed are omitted.
